notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 11842; AKU grapheme X0060 (AKU GR 852). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: X5 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 571. Occurrence: line 7.1; find place Ägypten (unlokalisiert); writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 2.9 x 7.2 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Zweite Zwischenzeit, 17. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
